native.scope: Actual five-cell fixture: four DFFs, two disjoint Q-to-D branches and original sd3 obstacle; exactly two new sd3 cells/two nets. Global routing before and after and full min/max STA at fast/typical/slow. No full-chip or timing-closure acceptance.
native.development_note: Fixture-only direct ODB negative mutations leave stale parasitic invalidation. Before real insertion, placement estimation clears that cache and full global routing plus routed estimation restores the recorded mode. Both consecutive native insertions then succeed without an intervening cache workaround; final routed timing is rebuilt after mutation restoration.

scope: Exactly two delay cells on separate source-bound DFF Q-to-D branches. Tiny native tests only completed locally. Actual chip baseline, full graph/object contraction, protected status,32SRAM,all endpoint tables,all historical guards,two fresh process reloads and both limited digital ECO proofs are mandatory in GitHub. No detailed route,signoffRC,LVS,boot or production acceptance.

checked_contracts: Exact completed single-delay producer run/source/artifact/result/view pins and its frozen validator are mandatory before the overlay is used. Existing original sd3 is retained.
Two target branches are disjoint sole DFF Q-to-D nets with source-bound native expressions, functional pin equations and placements; no scalar/bus name substitution is inferred.
Unchanged single-insertion bodies execute in two namespaces with reserved-prefix replacement only. First insertion remains a real obstacle for the second vacancy search.

Native total and sequential counts require exactly two new cells and two new nets; combined graph contraction and object hashes include all original PG terminals, nets, masters, coordinates, orientations, statuses and dont_touch flags.
Native full-update and two independent fresh-route reloads preserve exported ODB/SDC pins, exact original objects, all 32 SRAMs, complete endpoint/corner identity and exact repeatability.
Eight immutable historical reference metrics and the reproduced candidate baseline all require no regression, plus actual hold improvement. Unchanged input is correctly rejected as not improved.

Two actual limited ECO proofs bind original C10 to exact parent, and exact parent to new export. Raw result status, process return codes, Liberty/macro inputs, and every proof input pin remain mandatory.
Native tiny controls precede chip loading; always startup/progress/final artifact captures include hidden source files, and final validation remains mandatory. No native elapsed watchdog is added.
integration_peer_review.independence_scope: Reviewer authored only sw/tests/timing_pair_hold_native.tcl. This is an independent review of the other seven files/integration, not an independent authorship review of the fixture. Root independently replayed the tiny fixture.
limitations: This is source/API/guard review and focused local tests, not an executed full-chip pair trial. Fresh routed estimates are not signoff RC/DRC/LVS or production timing closure.
